title: Replace a lost, stolen or damaged bus driver authority online
summary: You can apply for a replacement bus driver authority online if your current card is lost, stolen, damaged, or destroyed.
intro:
If your bus driver authority card is lost, stolen, damaged or destroyed, you can apply for a replacement online.

You'll also need to apply for a replacement if you have moved interstate or have moved from interstate to NSW.

There is no fee for replacing your driver authority.
who_can_apply: You must currently hold a bus driver authority.
what_you_need: A copy of your current Australian driver licence (scanned as a PDF)
A copy of a proof of identity document (if you hold an interstate driver licence)
A digital photo (if you do not hold a valid NSW driver licence and have not submitted a previous online application)

more_info.text: Your application cannot be saved to continue at a later date.
If your application is submitted successfully, you'll receive an email and PDF copy of your application.

faqs.q: Is there a fee to replace my bus driver authority?
faqs.a: No, there is no fee for replacing your driver authority.

faqs.q: Who can apply for a replacement authority?
faqs.a: You can apply for a replacement authority if you currently hold a bus driver authority.

faqs.q: When do I need to apply for a replacement authority?
faqs.a: You must also apply for a replacement if you have moved interstate or have moved from interstate to NSW.
